summary: Close BUG-0246's release-validation gap by smoke-starting the exact Controller package before publication; exercise real working and CGO-disabled package fixtures in both push/PR CI workflows, and reconcile stale Phase 2 and package-release status.

guide.reason: Release validation and contributor commands only; installed operator workflows do not change. Status corrections reflect the existing Phase 2 closure.

api.reason: API impact: none. The check calls existing UI, source and session routes on an isolated Controller. No client-facing API, Controller operation, Core command or observed result contract changes.

roadmap.reason: No milestone closes or product capability changes. README and the production handoff are aligned with the already recorded Phase 2 closure and published 0.3.1 package evidence; the website already reflects those outcomes.

state.reason: No product durable record changes. The smoke process creates a temporary Controller database and credentials, removes them, and neither enrolls hosts nor connects to an existing Controller.

verification.method: python3 tests/integration/controller_package_smoke.py passed locally and inside a disposable Debian 13 container with real CGO-enabled and CGO-disabled Controller binaries in synthetic packages: the working package initialized SQLite, served UI/source and authenticated; the broken one was rejected with the original SQLite stub diagnostic. Focused package smoke wiring, distribution packaging, CI security, documentation-gate and privacy unit checks passed. API generation and worktree documentation checks passed. Independent review found no remaining substantive defects. New release artifact and hosted workflow execution are not claimed; see QA for limits.
